sentences.en: The oil in mayonnaise sometimes separates from the other ingredients.
sentences.zh: 蛋黄酱里的油有时会与其他成分分层。

sentences.en: The old Italian oil painting was never exhibited in public.
sentences.zh: 那幅古老的意大利油画从未公开展出过。

sentences.en: Oil on canvas can never paint a petal so delicate.
sentences.zh: 在画布上作画永远无法画出如此娇嫩的花瓣。

senses.zh: 油 - 石油 - 油画；油画颜料 -
